# MindSage Frontend Documentation Map

Use this file as the low-token entrypoint for AI coding tools.

## Core

- `README.md` — setup, Docker, configuration, and project structure.
- `INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md` — agent-oriented install and verification guide.
- `SECURITY.md` — frontend privacy and security rules.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — development workflow.
- `AGENTS.md` — coding-agent instructions.
- `FRONTEND_AUDIT.md` — feature inventory and API surface.

## Key Code

- `src/App.tsx` — app routes and providers.
- `src/pages/Index.tsx` — main dashboard.
- `src/pages/Landing.tsx` — public-facing product page.
- `src/lib/api.ts` — API client and shared types.
- `src/components/home/MCPSetupPanel.tsx` — MCP client setup UI.
- `src/components/chat/ChatPanel.tsx` — chat/RAG UI.
- `src/components/consent/` — consent controls.
- `src/components/graph/` — knowledge graph canvas.
- `src/components/explore/` — document, image, and audio viewers.
